title: ManhattanGrid pause probability at intersections
description:
Add pause behavior at intersections:
- pause_probability parameter (0.0-1.0) for chance to pause at intersection
- Pause duration handling (fixed or random within range)
- Integration with intersection detection from sibling task
- State machine: MOVING -> PAUSED -> MOVING transitions

This completes the ManhattanGrid feature set.
close_reason: Implemented pause behavior in python/src/lichen/sim/mobility.py ManhattanGrid: pause_probability field 0.0-1.0 (:743, validated incl. NaN rejection) and pause_time_us fixed-int field (:742, default 5_000_000, validated >= 0) - config shape follows the module's RandomWaypoint/GroupMobility single-fixed-int pause_time_us convention (:84/:236), random-within-range intentionally not modeled and documented in the class docstring. State machine reuses WaypointState: _state + _pause_remaining_us fields, init MOVING, _handle_paused (:876) mirrors RandomWaypoint's zero-duration fall-through, _maybe_start_pause (:888) gates on detect_intersection then draws one Bernoulli per arrival (before the next direction pick) and never enters PAUSED when pause_time_us <= 0 - PAUSED always carries strictly positive remaining duration, so no 0us PAUSED<->MOVING ping-pong is reachable (uory P1 hazard avoided); pause entered at arrival survives step boundaries. Zero-RNG-draw guard (pause_probability <= 0.0 early return, :897) mirrors GroupMobility's jitter guard, preserving default trajectories and RNG stream bit-for-bit. Tests in tests/sim/test_manhattan_grid.py TestManhattanGridPause (9 new, :385) with an analytic independent oracle (10m legs @ 1 m/s, dt=0.1s, 30s window -> arrivals t=10/22, 26m traveled at p=1.0): p=0 draws zero Bernoulli (via _DrawCountingRandom :355, overriding getrandbits too because Random._randbelow falls back to random() when only random() is overridden), pause_time_us has no effect at p=0, p=1.0 fires at intersections with exact time conservation (26m), exactly 2 MOVING->PAUSED->MOVING cycles with stationary runs of exactly pause_time_us (20-21 samples, drift-robust), pause_time_us=0 never enters PAUSED, pause persists across step boundary, reset clears pause state, validation errors. Note: per-step float rounding can shift an arrival across a sample boundary with a 0us-truncated arrival step (pre-existing uory truncation, benign here since the following pause consumes time).
